attacks.claim: The QA table reports staff pilot results (0 misdelivered texts, 2 copy fixes re-verified) for a pilot the rollout schedules for Nov 2-6. Today is 2026-10-26, so these results cannot exist yet. Real-hold, real-carrier delivery evidence is being claimed without having been gathered.
attacks.evidence: "Staff pilot week (64 staff cards, real holds) | 0 misdelivered texts; 2 copy fixes shipped and re-verified" vs "Nov 2-6: flags on for staff cards only (pilot above)."

attacks.claim: The fixed public announcement says text alerts are for every cardholder. SMS is opt-in, and juvenile cards do not show the option at all, so the claim is inaccurate. This is a public statement that goes out on all channels and can't be recalled.
attacks.evidence: "Text alerts for holds, for every cardholder." vs "juvenile cards do not show it"

attacks.claim: QA lowered the spend cap to $5 on the production provider account. The artifact has no step confirming the cap was restored to $900 before launch, and a forgotten $5 cap would silently stop real texts.
attacks.evidence: "Spend cap reached (test cap $5)" ABSENT: cap restoration/verification step in Rollout

attacks.claim: Locker codes expire at the pickup deadline, but extended holds get 3 more days. The artifact doesn't say whether a new code is issued or how it is delivered.
attacks.evidence: "Codes are single-use, expire at the pickup deadline" vs "hold deadlines extend 3 days"
